exposure: ratio between the residual myometrial thickness (RMT) and adjacent myometrial thickness (AMT)
cohort: Women who underwent Caesarean section from January 2017 to June 2020 at a single tertiary medical centre
finding: A reduced RMT was found to be associated with heavy menstrual bleeding and intermenstrual spotting, while values below 2.5 mm were also associated with infertility.
